description: This file contains JavaScript code for configuring and managing the SCAYT (Spell Check As You Type) dialog options within the CKEditor rich text editor. It defines dialog UI elements, event handlers, and functions related to language, dictionary, and spell check settings.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.ui.dialog.scaytItemList
classes.description: Custom UI element class for displaying and managing a list of words in the SCAYT dialog.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns a new instance of the specified CKEDITOR UI dialog element.
